description: Dual-mode sitemap: a lightweight static-sitemap enhancer (nav-enhance) or an interactive information-architecture tree with badges and an org-chart visual mode (ia-tree)

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: Behavior mode: nav-enhance (static sitemap enhancer) or ia-tree (interactive IA tree)

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL to JSON data (nav-enhance: { children: [{ title, href, children }] }, ia-tree: { title, pages }). Strings render as text; only http(s), relative and fragment hrefs become links.

attributes.name: data-label-controls
attributes.description: [nav-enhance] Accessible name of the controls landmark

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: [ia-tree] Site map heading and tree name. Changing it rebuilds the tree.

attributes.name: collapsed
attributes.description: [ia-tree] Start all nodes collapsed. Changing it rebuilds the tree.

attributes.name: data-view
attributes.description: [ia-tree] Set to "visual" for the SVG org-chart visualization. Changing it rebuilds.

attributes.name: data-orientation
attributes.description: [ia-tree visual] Layout orientation. The toolbar flips it; setting it re-renders the chart.

attributes.name: data-detail
attributes.description: [ia-tree visual] Node detail: 0 shape, 1 title, 2 full, 3 full + status, 4 wireframe. The toolbar slider sets it; setting it re-renders the chart.

childAttributes.name: data-page-type
childAttributes.description: [ia-tree] Page type: layout | section | dashboard | page | modal | redirect

childAttributes.name: data-template
childAttributes.description: [ia-tree] Template or view name shown as a badge

childAttributes.name: data-status
childAttributes.description: [ia-tree] Page status: draft | ready | live | deprecated

childAttributes.name: data-sitemap
childAttributes.description: [nav-enhance] Marks a sitemap nav for the outline styling outside a <site-map> (inside one, the child nav is styled without it)

childAttributes.name: data-sitemap-section
childAttributes.description: [nav-enhance] A top-level item that is a headed block: an <h2> followed by a <ul> of groups laid out side by side

childAttributes.name: data-sitemap-leaves
childAttributes.description: [nav-enhance] A long run of leaf pages that flows into columns

childAttributes.name: data-sitemap-label
childAttributes.description: [nav-enhance] Label of a branch that has no page of its own

events.name: site-map:ready
events.description: [ia-tree] Fired after the tree (or visual chart) is built

events.name: site-map:select
events.description: [ia-tree] A node or its link was clicked

events.name: site-map:pages-changed
events.description: [ia-tree] Fired after assigning the pages property rebuilds the tree

properties.name: pages
properties.type: Array<{ label, href?, pageType?, template?, status?, children? }>
properties.description: [ia-tree] Get the page tree as data, or assign one to rebuild (collapse state resets)
